apps.name: Demo Bot
apps.description: Responds to a 'hello' with a reply in channel, responds to a 'ping' with a reply in thread, and responds to a 'ghost' message with an ephemeral reply in channel visible only to the sender. Send '/echo hey' to echo your message back to the channel. Also responds to 'app_mention' events.

slashCommands.description: Echo your message back to the channel
